qualification: Hand-authored physical controls. Coordinates and glyphs are independent expected data, not captured output or a renderer oracle. v2 binds each literal scene to one exact pinned source Model after a paid direction-only projection and proves every same-topology source record has the identical direction-normalized Model and authored edge order.
revision_from_r1: R1 rotated narrow TD/BT child frames into LR/RL, so ten labels did not fit. R2 manually assigns horizontal widths/routes; no renderer capture is used. R7 preserves all eight literal good scenes and supersedes only the declared negative-control catalogue and hand-source binding contract; v1 remains frozen.

point_target_contract.one_way_end: A normal one-way target uses the existing producer/oracle contract: straight perimeter glyph at the border and an arrow exactly one exterior cell away facing that border.
point_target_contract.junction_at_target: Not accepted. A target junction would require a changed producer contract and can conceal an extra arm.
point_target_contract.source: A source uses source_port-style junction glyph with its outward normal and original perimeter tangent arms.

construction_contract.frame: Draw listed rectangles with exact light outlines, then horizontal labels at label_start, route glyphs, source ports, arrow heads, and one full following-token row. Target ports are untouched outline glyphs.
construction_contract.port: A group endpoint is legal only at declared group border+normal; a vertex endpoint only at declared child border+normal.
construction_contract.route: Every listed route is consumed exactly once by its tagged edge; a group crossing is never an endpoint.
construction_contract.no_implicit_transform: All eight scenes are literal coordinates; a future test may share a grid builder but must not rotate producer output.
construction_contract.rank_cycle: The topology-A hand scene intentionally projects three→two and two→c2 to a frontier quotient cycle. It is a complete good scene: rank ordering is suppressed only for that quotient-cycle component, never by fabricating child-to-group semantic edges.
construction_contract.declared_controls: Each declared control names a concrete well-formed wrong expectation or a literal physical corruption. A semantic control is decoded from a rebuilt wire Model before geometry; resource/model-schema failures do not count as physical ownership rejections.

negative_controls.mutation: Change the tagged group:two target from vertex:c2 to vertex:b1 while retaining a well-formed decoded Model and the Grid.
negative_controls.must_reject: The grid owns the tagged target at child c2, not sibling child b1.

negative_controls.mutation: Change the tagged S1→S2 source to sibling group S2 while retaining a well-formed decoded Model and the Grid.
negative_controls.must_reject: Named group endpoint identity is exact.

negative_controls.mutation: Change the group:two source tag of group_to_child to vertex:b1 in a well-formed decoded Model without changing the Grid.
negative_controls.must_reject: The grid owns group two perimeter, not child b1.

negative_controls.mutation: Replace the downward S1 group-source junction on its bottom straight border with a right-facing junction.
negative_controls.must_reject: A tangential contact is not a legal outward group endpoint.
Perimeter arms require exclusive route ownership.

negative_controls.mutation: Retag child-crossing ordinary edge sub1→sub4 as tagged sub1→group:S1 in a rebuilt well-formed Model while retaining the Grid.
negative_controls.must_reject: The S1 boundary crossing is not the tagged endpoint; the Grid still ends at child sub4.

negative_controls.mutation: Remove sub4 from S2 direct membership in a rebuilt well-formed Model.
negative_controls.must_reject: Existing group membership obligations remain active.

negative_controls.mutation: Reuse source_edge_order index 1 and omit index 2.
negative_controls.must_reject: Ordinary plus tagged source order is an exact partition.
